use: Research evidence only. Not a trading signal, not advice, and not used by the live signal path.
title: SEC earnings catalysts: anomalies from filings, decision time, reaction
headline: 9,614 earnings events from SEC filings: recurring operating improvements react +2.22% vs -0.51% without an anomaly; 20-day drift -0.10% (interval includes zero). Extraction: 86% of periodic filings carry usable facts; 97% of events matched to their 8-K 2.02 release.
caveats: Facts are copied verbatim from SEC XBRL company facts; the anomaly rules, thresholds and the recurring-vs-one-time label are interpretation (v1, declared a priori, not tuned).
'One-time suspected' means net income moved without a matching operating move; no specific item was identified in the filing text.
Decision time is the acceptance timestamp of the 8-K Item 2.02 release matched to the periodic report; releases accepted during the session (intraday) are only partly reflected in the same-day bar.
Sample: 400 liquid symbols with Donchian breakouts, 9,614 events; ticker-to-CIK uses today's SEC file projected back (reconstructed basis).
The anomaly thresholds flag about a third of all earnings events: they select directionally, they do not isolate rare events.
Market adjustment uses an equal-weight index of the stored universe; the no-anomaly group shows a negative average reaction against it, so compare groups, not absolute levels.
The breakout, exit-policy and combination cells are many and small; none is a confirmed edge.

outcome_table.label_note: labels are realised outcomes on the reaction session (ar_react), +5 and +20 sessions after it (ar_d5, ar_d20); features are known at the release acceptance time

bullish_combinations_by_year.rule: a year counts when the cell and the plain bullish breakout both have >= 30 trades; better = higher mean net R (fixed 3R, 10 bps)

timing_quality.reading: a correct mapping puts the large absolute gap on the reaction bar and a baseline-sized one on the bar before it (placebo); INTRADAY releases show their move in the bar's own range, not the gap

breakout_outcome_table.label_note: r_net10__<variant key> = realised R net of 10 bps round trip under that registered exit policy; catalyst = class of the most recent earnings event within 15 days before the signal
